tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// rta mgrin khyung gshog can gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin khyung gshog can bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ rgyas pa la spro na/ tshogs kyi zhing spyan drang ba dang*/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ bsdus pa la spro na/ sems bskyed pa'i rjes thogs nyid la/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ rang gi sems hrīḥlas padma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mchog sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon sngo ba'i dbu gsum gyi steng na rgya cher bzhad cing 'tsher ba'i rta mgo ljang zhur/ rngog ma dmar po dang ldan pa gsum yod pa/ zhal re re la dmar zhing 'khrug pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje dang*/ be con dang*/ zhags pa/ g.yon gsum na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ ral gri dang*/ rab tu gdengs pa'i phyag gi sor mo lnga las rigs lnga'i bya khyung 'phro ba/ rdo rje'i gshog pa kun tu gdengs pas phyogs kyi khongs rgyas par khyab pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad bskum pas pho rgyud kyi gdon dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ g.yon brkyang bas mo rgyud kyi tshogs mnan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rtsa zhal gyi mtshog ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan zhing*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par dmigs pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag go /sngags zlo bar 'dod pas snying gi nang nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥbasam pa'i mtha' ma sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs nas/

oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas so// de nas shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs te/ mdun du spyan drangs pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mchog la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu i daṃ ba li kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags kyis dbul zhing mchod la/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab ste/ gshegs su gsol lo// rta mgrin khyung gshog can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin shing phag khra zla'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin par 'phags pas tre'i sa char bkod pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
